response.sql: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS z, s.entrystat AS st, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS a FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), base AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM site_avg), st_avg AS (SELECT st, AVG(a) AS sa FROM site_avg WHERE st IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st), kept AS (SELECT sa1.z, sa1.a, base.b AS b, st_avg.sa AS sa FROM site_avg sa1 JOIN st_avg ON st_avg.st = sa1.st CROSS JOIN base WHERE base.b IS NOT NULL AND sa1.a > st_avg.sa) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_kept_face_avg, AVG(a - b) AS avg_excess_over_baseline, AVG(a - sa) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM kept
